name: Rosemary
description: An evergreen shrub with needle-like leaves and a strong, piney smell. Small blue flowers appear in spring.

image.alt: Rosemary branches with thin needle-like leaves

uses.title: Kitchen
uses.text: Roast potatoes, bread and roasted vegetables.

uses.title: Skewers
uses.text: Woody stems can be used as skewers on the grill.

uses.title: Garden
uses.text: Early flowers feed the first bees of spring.

growingTips.title: Sun
growingTips.text: Give it the sunniest, warmest spot you have.

growingTips.title: Soil
growingTips.text: Light, well-drained soil; wet roots kill it.

growingTips.title: Winter
growingTips.text: Protect it from hard frost, or bring the pot inside.

growingTips.title: Pruning
growingTips.text: Trim after flowering, but not into the bare old wood.
